text:
jess: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR that touches our on-prem auth flow + secrets handling. Would like a security sign-off before merging. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823 :eyes:

michael: Looking now. Main things I flagged in the description: KMS key usage, env var naming, and VPC egress rule additions. Can you list which services need access to the KMS key?

jess: Sure — runtime-gateway, model-loader, and the vm-scheduler service. I added an IAM policy snippet in the PR. Also added an opt-in rotate_on_deploy flag (default false) because we don't want automatic rotation until Ops is ready.

sara: tagging @alan for crypto/KMS review. Alan — do you want a quick diff or should we walk through in a call?

alan: quick diff first please. The KMS calls look fine at glance, but need to ensure key aliasing matches our migration plan. One note: don't embed raw key IDs in config; use alias and let HSM/KMS resolve.

jess: acknowledged. Updated PR with alias usage and removed the explicit key id. Also added a small migration script:
```bash
# copy alias to new key and update CMKs
python tools/migrate_kms_alias.py --from alias/old --to alias/new
```

michael: CI is failing on `test_vpc_routing` — seems unrelated to auth change, flaky. I re-ran workflows. deploy-bot reported: `deploy-bot: canary test passed in staging` earlier today.

deploy-bot: CI re-run succeeded. All checks are green except the security-review label is missing.

jess: Requesting explicit security-review label + one approval from eng-security. Target merge window: Thu 03/19 02:00 UTC (off-peak). If anyone from eng-security can add the label today, would be great.

alan: I'll add the `security-review` label and leave comments inline. Two asks: 1) confirm secrets rotation policy works with on-prem HSM (ops to confirm), 2) confirm network policy doesn't inadvertently open egress to public IPs.

sara: ops is aware; I'll follow up and confirm HSM compatibility. For network policy, I left a comment suggesting more specific CIDR rules rather than 0.0.0.0/0 for the new egress rule.

michael: small nit on variable naming — prefer `KMS_ALIAS` to `KMS_KEY_ALIAS` for parity with other repos. jess, can you rename?

jess: done. Pushed a commit (f3a9c2b).

alan: LGTM after the alias change and after Ops confirms HSM integration. Adding `security-review` label now. :white_check_mark:

security-review-bot: Label `security-review` added by alan at 1782004000.

jess: Thanks all. I'll hold merge until Ops confirms HSM and until the scheduled window. If anything else pops up, ping this thread. :pray:
